community_note.text: Readers added context they thought people might want to know. The station referenced as 'the rings' in this post is Halcyon-9, a private orbital platform owned by the poster. The coffee described is sourced from the last 14 kilograms of Ethiopian Yirgacheffe known to exist in the galaxy, grown under license on a closed agricultural moon the poster also owns. The 'toast' is made from wheat cultivated in a gravity-stabilized vault the poster commissioned in 2847. The construction and annual operating cost of Halcyon-9 exceeds the combined GDP of 31 inhabited worlds [1][2]. The sunrise referenced is scheduled. [1] Galactic Wealth Registry, Tier-Beyond Disclosures, Q3 3026. [2] Dr. Chen-Okafor, 'Private Orbital Infrastructure and the Failure of Gini Coefficients,' Solar Economic Review, 3024. [3] vibes.
